shared_or_similar_visual_information: A line or boundary made of separated short strokes.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It represents an edge on the hidden rear part of the icosahedron. Right image: It indicates a cut position through the folded wire.
Rationales: The left dashes convey occlusion in a three-dimensional wireframe. The scissors and the vertical broken guide on the right explicitly identify a cutting position through the wire. The two stroke styles therefore encode different contextual functions.
